other_text: There is no way anyone can watch this short without shrieking in horror... For the rest of us horror nuts get your eyeballs on this and enjoy the vileness of Hangnail... You'll have a hard time watching without bolting away. Hangnail is a dark treat... Hangnail is a body horror saturated with blood and bone... This is low budget indie-film-making thinking big. Bravo...
moderation_notes: Contains graphic depictions of blood and body horror.
description: A poster featuring a close-up of a hand with bloodied nails, promoting the horror short film 'Hangnail' by onStream Productions.
